attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Tennessee state income tax per hypothetical Form TN-1040. Tennessee uses progressive tax brackets: 2% on first $50,000, 4% on $50,000-$100,000, 6% above $100,000. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status ($6,000 Single, $12,000 MFJ), then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_dsl: set result.tn_tax = 0; add " TN has no state income tax: $0" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.action_postfix: "TENNESSEE FORM TN-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.tn_agi xdef 0 /result.tn_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.tn_bracket_2_tax xdef 0 /result.tn_bracket_3_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate TN tax MFJ. NOTE: TN has no state income tax (2025) — actual state tax is $0. Postfix retains legacy hypothetical-bracket logic referencing TN constants not in TN_edd; EL form below honors no-income-tax acceptance criterion.
action_details.action_dsl: set result.tn_tax = 0; add " TN has no state income tax: $0" to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.tn_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto tn_standard_deduction_mfj /result.tn_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" result.tn_standard_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.tn_agi result.tn_standard_deduction f- 0 fmax /result.tn_taxable_income xdef " TN Taxable Income: $" result.tn_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Std Deduction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.tn_taxable_income tn_bracket_3_threshold f> if tn_bracket_2_threshold tn_bracket_1_rate f* /result.tn_bracket_1_tax xdef tn_bracket_3_threshold tn_bracket_2_threshold f- tn_bracket_2_rate f* /result.tn_bracket_2_tax xdef result.tn_taxable_income tn_bracket_3_threshold f- tn_bracket_3_rate f* /result.tn_bracket_3_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (2% on $0-$50,000): $" result.tn_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (4% on $50,000-$100,000): $" result.tn_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 3 (6% above $100,000): $" result.tn_bracket_3_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.tn_taxable_income tn_bracket_2_threshold f> if tn_bracket_2_threshold tn_bracket_1_rate f* /result.tn_bracket_1_tax xdef result.tn_taxable_income tn_bracket_2_threshold f- tn_bracket_2_rate f* /result.tn_bracket_2_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (2% on $0-$50,000): $" result.tn_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (4%): $" result.tn_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.tn_taxable_income tn_bracket_1_rate f* /result.tn_bracket_1_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (2%): $" result.tn_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif endif result.tn_bracket_1_tax result.tn_bracket_2_tax f+ result.tn_bracket_3_tax f+ /result.tn_tax xdef " Total TN Tax: $" result.tn_tax cvs strconcat " (Form TN-1040)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
